page_title: MNU 2-0 SUN | Manchester Utd v Sunderland 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Hjelde L. F. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
90+4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+3' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+2' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but Senne Lammens comes off his line to gather the ball.

90+1' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Senne Lammens blocks the shot with his legs.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Robin Roefs.
87' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Leny Yoro is replaced by Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
85' Substitution. Casemiro leaves the pitch and is replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
85' A dangerous towering header by Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
84' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Casemiro (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Stuart Attwell and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Here is a change. Trai Hume is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
79' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) will replace Bryan Mbeumo.
76' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Granit Xhaka (Sunderland).
73' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
70' A precise low pass is received by Casemiro (Manchester United), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
66' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) replacing Mason Mount.
64' That's the end of the game for Diogo Dalot, who is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
64' Trai Hume (Sunderland) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
64' The resulting set piece from Sunderland is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Sunderland force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Wilson Isidor will be replaced by Brian Brobbey (Sunderland).
58' Arthur Masuaku will be replaced by Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland).
58' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Bertrand Traore and he is replaced by Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).
57' Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
57' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
56' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
52' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
49' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
47' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Daniel Ballard (Sunderland).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' There's an opportunity for Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45+7' The Sunderland players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Stuart Attwell. NO PENALTY!
45+4' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
45+4' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That is a penalty kick for Sunderland.
45+2' Mason Mount (Manchester United) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Stuart Attwell who sees an offensive foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

44' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom right corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Senne Lammens does well to punch it away. Sunderland will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) brings an opponent down and Stuart Attwell interrupts the game.
37' Simon Adingra comes off the pitch to be replaced by Daniel Ballard (Sunderland).
35' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) picks up a yellow card.

31' 2 - 0 What a wonderful finish! Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
30' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle.
29' Caution goes to Omar Alderete (Sunderland).
27' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

24' OFF THE POST! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box. His effort was headed to the top right corner, but Robin Roefs came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the post.

23' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

21' Robin Roefs makes a brilliant save! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
16' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.

11' Manchester Utd slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
8' 1 - 0 Amazing piece of skill! Mason Mount (Manchester United) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is!
6' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) tries to find Granit Xhaka, but he puts too much power on the pass.
4' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) is adjudged offside.

3' Mason Mount (Manchester United) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Sunderland will kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
